newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's Le Moteur reports H1 profit.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's Le Moteur reports H1 profit.

text.p: Tunisian company Le Moteur had a 256,000 dinars interim profits during the first half of 1996, results showed.
Figures for the same period last year were not available for comparison, but Le Moteur posted 1.51 million dinars net profit for the whole year 1995.
Le Moteur, which trades in agricultural equipment, has a capital of three million dinars.
It was last priced on the Tunis Stock Exchange at 27.07 dinars per share.
